From: Oakridge Security <assessor@oakridge-sec.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: emergency patch provenance and approver trail

Hi Avery,

Oakridge is kicking off the Close-out for ClearBank's SIG/SOC2 review and we need a compact package showing how Redwood handles emergency production patches (definition: code or infra changes applied outside of regular release windows to remediate security issues or high-severity incidents). Specifically we need: 

- A chronological list of emergency patches since 2026-01-01 with ticket IDs, author, change window, and rollout timestamps.
- The approval matrix (who can approve emergency vs standard changes) and evidence of approvals for three representative patches (PDF or signed DocuSign is fine).
- CI/CD provenance: build artifacts (image sha/tarball id), pipeline run IDs, and short job logs showing the deployment steps.
- Any key rotation or ephemeral credential replacement done as part of the patch (logs or commit refs).

Please confirm whether you can provide these artifacts by EOD Tue 2026-10-20. We will need at least one live-call to walk through redacted logs if possible.

Thanks,
Sam Ortega
Oakridge Security – Senior Assessor
assessor@oakridge-sec.com
